detail_definitions.timestamps > speed_world_units_per_raw_t: Horizontal distance divided by raw ts difference, over consecutive movement rows of a file sorted by (ts, file order). share_above_5 is the share of pairs above 5.001. median_first_gap is the median over files of the raw ts difference between a file's first two movement rows.
detail_definitions.timestamps > Position_distance_by_gap_le: Consecutive Position rows of a file sorted by (ts, file order), grouped by their raw ts difference. median_distance_per_unit_of_gap divides each pair's horizontal distance by its ts difference.
detail_definitions.timestamps > human_file_starts_by_utc_ho: Files with Position rows, counted by the UTC hour of their smallest raw ts read as Unix seconds. The six-hour windows wrap around midnight.
detail_definitions.matches > duration: Largest minus smallest raw ts over the files recorded for a match. It is an observed span, not the length of the match.
detail_definitions.duplicates > within_file_copies_directly: Surplus identical rows whose previous row in file order is identical on all eight columns, as a share of all surplus identical rows within a file.
detail_definitions.deaths > files_by_actor_and_fate: Fate is the event of the file's first death row in (ts, file order), or 'no death row'.
detail_definitions.deaths > storm_deaths_seconds_into_match: Raw ts of the KilledByStorm row minus the smallest raw ts of its match.
detail_definitions.combat > rows_paired_with_rows_in_anothe: For each row of the first kind: partner rows in the same match, in another file, with a raw ts at most 1 away. Distance is horizontal, to the nearest such partner.
detail_definitions.combat > distance_from_event_row_to_near: Horizontal distance from each non-movement row to the movement row of the same file that is nearest in time.
detail_definitions.cleaning: The four rules are applied in order, each to what the previous one left. Actor (human or bot) comes from the movement event of the file.
